android.desc:
Web browser optimised to use with TV remote.
Features:
- working with TV remote
- tabs and bookmarks support
- voice search support
- built-in download manager
- browsing history
- ad and popup blocking
- built-in optimized video player
- and now there’s also a version for phones, with support for tabs and bookmarks exchange

Now opensource:
https://github.com/truefedex/tv-bro

quotes.text:
The TV companies' complaint against Downloader is completely meritless. If you're looking for an alternative to Downloader, I recommend TV Bro:

- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.phlox.tvwebbrowser

- Source code: https://github.com/truefedex/tv-bro

I think TV Bro is the only free and open source browser app available on Android TV. The current version lets you choose between GeckoView (Firefox engine) and the default Android WebView (Chrome engine). It integrates an ad blocker and has more features than Downloader.
quotes.story_title: Google Bans ‘Downloader’ App: TV Outfits Claim Browser Violates Injunction
